result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that appears mostly functional. Found 3 minor to major issues related to content truncation and duplicate listings.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' entries appear side by side in the 'Fastest near you' section with the same delivery time (15-25 min) and price (€0.90 delivery), which looks like a duplicate listing error.
issues.suggestion: Verify whether these are truly two distinct restaurants; if duplicated in error, deduplicate the listing.

issues.description: The third item in 'Fastest near you' ('Smash Bros Bu...') is cut off on the right edge, showing truncated restaurant name and image.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for a horizontal carousel, but ensure the truncation is intentional and the item is fully accessible via horizontal scroll.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is partially cut off with no visible restaurant name or details visible above the bottom navigation.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card content becomes fully visible on scroll and that partial card display is intentional preview behavior.
